role: antecedent and consequent propositions or corresponding events
notes: The active comparison declares whether a proposition or a probability event is intended.

role: schematic conjunctions of two propositional states
notes: Juxtaposition means conjunction; an unspecified initial-model component is not a negative assertion.

role: conditional-probability assessment of B given not-A
notes: Requires positive probability of not-A; not the probability of a material-implication event.

role: specified formulas in a compatibility counterexample
notes: P_0 is the inclusive disjunction and Q_0 the material conditional.

role: set of two-proposition truth assignments satisfying a formula
notes: Nonempty intersection expresses compatibility; subset inclusion expresses entailment.

role: counterfactual value after replacing B's equation
notes: Reuses P16 same-background semantics; evidence B=1 remains factual.

role: binary background unit in the stipulated causal illustration
notes: Two values each have probability one-half; not an empirical participant model.

role: endogenous variables in the stipulated causal illustration
notes: Locally typed variables rather than antecedent/consequent events or belief/common-knowledge operators.

role: rose poppy lily and unnamed category events
notes: Mutual exclusivity and exhaustiveness are explicit local assumptions; P here is not the probability function.

role: single-category domain for the complement comparison
notes: Binary or three-category exhaustive domain; an unnamed category supplies the nonexhaustive countercase.
